researched.name: Bhagyanagar India Ltd
researched.trigger: price: Copper - LME US$14,788/t on 2026-09-21 at 98% of its 52-week range (+5.3% 1w, +24.4% 6m); MetalBook Mumbai copper CC rod Rs 1,410/kg dated 2026-09-16, +48.3% y/y, highest of 17 readings since 2025-07-08; HS 7407 import unit price +157.5% smoothed y/y to Jul-2026
researched.reason: Exposure and transmission both documented from the company's own filings. Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 705.08 cr on 5,278 MT at a stated realisation of Rs 1,279/kg (Rs 846/kg a year earlier, +51.2%), EBITDA margin 3.33% -> 5.43%, PAT Rs 7.57 cr -> Rs 20.25 cr while VOLUME FELL 6.5%. The mechanism is quoted from the 28-Jul-2026 call transcript: purchases at 86-95% of LME, sales LME-linked, 'if the prices go up 20%, my margin will still remain at 5%, but the EBITDA per kg will go up 20%', with ~85% of inventory hedged on exchange - so this is a margin-per-kg pass-through, explicitly NOT the inventory-gain story the map attributed to copper recyclers. Capacity 35,000 MTPA online (FY26 utilisation 70.4%), 45,000 MTPA guided for ~Jun-FY28. Market cap Rs 1,490.3 cr sits inside the Rs 300-7,500 cr band the 2026-09-22 study found the odds peak in. Published with the demerger stated as the central caveat.
researched.caveats: The copper business demerges OUT of this scrip into Tieramet Ltd (to be listed separately) under a composite scheme NCLT Hyderabad approved on 07-Sep-2026; BIL retains three land parcels and a 9 MW windmill. Entitlement 1:1, record date not announced in any filing read this run. Also: promoter shares (12,73,335) pledged to fund MCX hedging margin, a transfer that showed publicly as a promoter SALE from 16-Jan-2026 until reversed on 24-Aug-2026; a Rs 750 cr material RPT with Tieramet on the 30-Sep-2026 AGM agenda; stock +388% in one year and closed at the top of its 52-week range.

researched.name: Subex Ltd
researched.trigger: filing: ORDER - contract with a major APAC mobile network operator for Partner Ecosystem Management, US$5 mn over 5 years (Annexure A, BSE filing 23-Sep-2026 12:36)
researched.reason: Highest-scoring candidate of the day (score 8, volume 16.4x its 60-day median, closing at the window high after +89.1% over 65 days), and the order value was read from the filing's own Annexure A - US$5 mn, five years, option to extend two more. It fails both halves of the 2026-09-22 order study. SIZE: TTM revenue is Rs 266.29 cr (Jun-26 72.78 + Mar-26 64.56 + Dec-25 65.44 + Sep-25 63.51). At any rupee between 80 and 95 to the dollar the contract is Rs 40-47.5 cr in TOTAL, i.e. Rs 8-9.5 cr a year, 3.0-3.6% of one year's sales - the under-10%-of-sales bucket that reached 2x 21.4% of the time, not the 25-50% bucket that reached 35.7%. RARITY: this is Subex's fourth order-award filing in the 187 days the BSE announcement page returns (23-Sep, 26-Aug, 21-Aug, 21-May 2026), so it is a serial filer, not the first-in-two-years profile. Valuation leaves no room either: TTM PAT is Rs 7.85 cr on the same four quarters, so the trailing PE at Rs 1,240.3 cr market cap is about 158x, matching the BSE header's 157.64. No exchange rate was taken from a document this run, which is why the order is stated as a bounded range rather than a single rupee figure.

researched.name: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Ltd
researched.trigger: filing: ORDER - Rs 3.64 cr from Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai, Indian Railways for manufacture, supply and installation of 40 sets of one coach set of chairs, to be executed by 08-Nov-2026 (BSE filing 23-Sep-2026 14:24)
researched.reason: Order value read from the filing: Rs 3,63,91,200. Against FY26 revenue of Rs 172.50 cr that is 2.1% of a year's sales - the weakest size bucket in the study. And it is the sixth order-award filing in the 85 days the announcement page covers (23-Sep, 11-Sep, 25-Aug, 29-Jul, 22-Jul, 10-Jul 2026): a serial bidder, the profile that reached 2x only 17.3% of the time and 5x never. A routine ICF supply order of this size is business as usual, not a trigger.

researched.name: ITCONS E-Solutions Ltd
researched.trigger: filing: ORDER - Rs 0.99 cr manpower-outsourcing contract (13 resources, 2 years from 24-Sep-2026) from the Department of Defence Research & Development, Office of DG (MSS), Ministry of Defence (BSE filing 23-Sep-2026 16:11)
researched.reason: Order value read from the filing: INR 99,33,877.4 inclusive of all taxes, spread over two years. Against FY26 revenue of Rs 87.74 cr that is 1.1% of a single year's sales in total, or about 0.6% a year - far below the bar, notwithstanding the Ministry of Defence counterparty. ITCONS has filed 19 order awards in the 216 days the announcement page covers (2026-02-20 to 2026-09-23), the most extreme serial-filer profile of the three order filings read today. For context the stock is -52.3% over one year and closed at Rs 251.9 against a 52-week low of Rs 249.35.

The filings lane produced three order filings and published none of them: all three values were read from the filings themselves and all three fail the 2026-09-22 order study on both axes - Subex US$5 mn over five years is 3.0-3.6% of a year's sales from a company on its fourth order filing in 187 days, Oriental Rail Rs 3.64 cr is 2.1% of FY26 sales on its sixth in 85 days, ITCONS Rs 0.99 cr over two years is 1.1% of a year's sales on its nineteenth in 216 days.
